protocol.selection: lowest mean final validation cross-entropy across 3 paired seeds per architecture; tie lower lr
protocol.test: 512 fixed independent synthetic samples; only 4 selected configurations x 3 seeds
protocol.normalization: BatchNorm train for optimizer steps; eval for all reported full-data metrics and fixed probes
protocol.optimizer: SGD momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0, no scheduler, no clipping
protocol.initialization: He fan_in conv; default Linear; BN gamma=1 beta=0
protocol.probe: first 32 training examples; eval-mode gradients; no updates
